criteria.description: Refactored code preserves identical functional behavior; cite existing regression test pass results and unchanged public interfaces.
Adhere to SOLID principles; decouple monolithic functions or classes into single-responsibility units; cite refactored class/function lines.
Eliminate duplicate code (DRY), minimize deeply nested branching, and lower cyclomatic complexity; cite simplified control flows.
Use expressive domain naming, eliminate dead code, and maintain concise docstrings; cite updated declarations.
